tools.name: safe_evaluate_matlab_code
tools.title: Safe MATLAB Code Evaluation
tools.description: Safely evaluates MATLAB code with a built-in content filter that rejects dangerous commands (e.g. clear, eval, system, quit). Set the project folder before evaluating.

code.description: MATLAB code to evaluate. Dangerous commands like clear, eval, system, quit etc. will be automatically rejected.

project_path.description: (Optional) Absolute path to the project folder. MATLAB sets this as the current working folder before execution.
